description:
Pushcraft turns push-ups into a game.

Use your phone’s camera to automatically track your reps, smash blocks, earn rewards, build towers, and challenge your friends. Every workout moves you forward, so your effort becomes something you can actually see.

Instead of simply counting reps, Pushcraft gives each push-up a purpose. As you train, you break through blocks, collect coins, earn XP, maintain your streak, and progress through increasingly impressive towers.

KEY FEATURES

AI PUSH-UP TRACKING  
Place your phone on the floor and start training. Pushcraft uses camera-based pose tracking to automatically count your push-ups so you can focus on your workout.

SMASH BLOCKS WITH EVERY REP  
Your movement powers the game. Lower yourself to charge your strike, then push back up to hit the block. Keep going until it breaks.

BUILD YOUR TOWERS  
Every workout contributes to your progression. Start with a foundation and work your way through multiple stages as your tower grows taller and more impressive.

PROGRESS THROUGH UNIQUE TOWERS  
Advance through a series of distinct towers, including Oakspire, Stonewatch, Frostkeep, Emberhold, and Skyward Spire. Each tower represents another step in your training journey.

BATTLE YOUR FRIENDS  
Create a battle, share your code, and challenge a friend to a push-up competition. Complete your run, compare scores, and see who comes out on top.

EARN COINS AND XP  
Breaking blocks and completing workouts rewards your effort. Build up your coins and XP as you continue training and progressing.

BUILD A DAILY STREAK  
Stay consistent by completing workouts regularly and keeping your streak alive.

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS  
View your total push-ups, completed workouts, completed towers, streak, coins, and other training stats from your profile.

BUILT TO MAKE PUSH-UPS MORE FUN  
Pushcraft combines fitness, progression, rewards, and friendly competition into one simple experience. Whether you're trying to build consistency, get stronger, or compete with friends, every rep helps you move forward.

Push. Break. Build.

Your strength builds the world.


SUBSCRIPTION REQUIRED
After completing the short setup, a Pushcraft subscription is required to track pushups and build towers.

For questions or support, email us at support@pushcraft.app
